relationships.subject: FTY720

relationships.subject: FTY720
relationships.evidence_quote: FTY720 treatment suppressed tumor progression determined by decreases in primary tumor volumes

key_findings: S1PR1 is upregulated in nerves of PDAC patients with pain and in DRGs of PDAC mice, in neurons and satellite glial cells.
S1PR1 antagonists W146 and FTY720 relieved PDAC pain and suppressed DRG TRPV1 and CGRP; FTY720 also partially reduced tumor growth.
